cost.machine: Ollama ~62k texts x 3 embedders serial (nomic, gemma ~15 min each by analogy to E0b; qwen3 UNSOURCED, priced by the 500-text pilot); CPU ~2-3 h single-threaded (the design's estimates)
cost.priced: UNPRICED (the cost-estimator has not priced stage 0)

plain_description.what: On three intent datasets with known answers (MASSIVE, CLINC150 with out-of-scope queries, Banking77), split so no text is shared, it checks four things with k-means and no tree build: whether results depend on the embedder; whether "no match" flags out-of-scope queries; whether a label-free cell margin predicts how pure a cell is; and whether a cell stays the same when slot words in the query are swapped.
plain_description.why: Checks against true labels whether the behaviours seen on MMLU-Pro (coarse level stable, fine level embedder-dependent) generalise, and whether label-free cells are trustworthy addresses.
plain_description.information: Confirms or narrows earlier MMLU-Pro claims. Result: fine structure depends on the embedder on all 3 datasets (nomic worse each time), while coarse differences stay within noise. "No match" detects CLINC's out-of-scope queries very well (AUROC 0.974, as good as a supervised method). The margin ranks cell purity on 2 of 3 datasets. But cells are not stable when slot words are swapped, so every filing rate of record now carries the note "surface-sensitive, untested on capability text". Short intent utterances only, one split.
